coverage.expected: Open via sidebar, actual content identity, cards/navigation; verify feature launch and status reflect service state.
Change palette, contrast, mode; inspect actual app theme and reopen persisted settings; revert.
Open Start Studio/Explorer Studio/Taskbar Designer; verify start style, taskbar registry values and restored state; native vs companion explicitly.
Select Gallery category, static/video/weather; observe actual desktop and scene, switch and restore; offline, RDP, GPU; no claim from screenshot alone.
Request System Monitor by button, verify visible widget and live samples, close/reopen, ensure no redundant settings switch; add/remove each widget, persist custom layouts.
Create/modify/apply zone to disposable test window; verify bounds and undo; keyboard preview is missing.
Create/rename/move/lock/tab/portal/rules/drag file in isolated fixture; verify actual filesystem and restore; test legacy migration.
Pin/unpin/reorder, edge, auto-hide, hover, actual window geometry and conflict with replacement taskbar.
Toggle when safe, play test audio; verify real visualization, metadata privacy and session suspend/restart; no microphone without consent.
Select tier, read service state and observed process metrics; verify diagnostics, cancel/export and no retained workers.
Save profile, create safe rule, trigger in isolated data, verify effect and restoration; Profiles alias is intentional.
Apply actual opacity/native alpha and persisted settings; toggle flags; reopen and restart; verify localization and themes.
Open Help/History, navigate tabs and validate content; versions, license, installer identity.
Conditional Media Suite installation: present only when detected; verify DSP using test audio, absent case explicit.
Conditional on installed approved plugin; actual route/load with pinned provider DLL, check feeds/widget and unload/disable.
Every visible enabled control has a stable ID and outcome/readback. Modal/destructive/network/admin controls isolated and explicitly approved; skipped or absent prerequisite never PASS.

rules: One row per actual control instance; distinguish missing, disabled with reason, exercised, passed, failed, blocked, skipped.
No blind clicking destructive or network actions; disposable fixtures and explicit safe probes.
Every supported locale/theme/size/monitor profile including 14 locales, 100/150/200 DPI, collapsed/expanded sidebar, scroll; actual Windows 11 interactive mandatory.
Inspect screenshot artifacts visually, not just file existence.
Retest full frozen candidate after fixes.
